subject: review of Python MCMC + behavior of PyStan in IPython Notebook

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: review of Python MCMC + behavior of PyStan in IPython Notebook
parts:
Aleks Jakulin just sent me a pointer to this review of MCMC options
in Python:

https://jakevdp.github.io/blog/2014/06/14/frequentism-and-bayesianism-4-bayesian-in-python/

It compares and contrasts Stan, Emcee and PyMCMC. Their main complaint
is that Stan is slow per iteration (no n_eff evals) and that it isn't
"Pythonic" enough. Can't argue with the latter, but the former was corrected
in many comments, though without a revised eval.

Aside from convincing me we need to get Peter's evals out, I noticed
this:

There is one more hiccup with this package: for some reason, PyStan
runs extremely slowly and crashes my computer when I run it in the
IPython notebook itself, but works without issues when I run it as
an executable Python file. I'm not sure why this is but it may have
something to do with this issue.

- Bob

messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] review of Python MCMC + behavior of PyStan in IPython Notebook
parts:
I've seen the post. I liked it! I don't know what to do about IPython notebook
(a web-based version of IPython (console)). I use PyStan from IPython all the
time, so I suspect if there's still a problem it's with this web-based
interface.

Hopefully an IPython notebook guru will figure it out...

Best,

-a
